detail.title: LLM Reasoning Blind Spots and Epistemic Navigation
detail.summary: This proposal continues the investigation into LLM reasoning blind spots using newly retrieved EACL 2026 conference proceedings (source-05c989bd8c754010, source-762858f5b5974369, source-f1099bec88e640f9). These sources provide substantive documentation on thought space exploration and blind spot navigation techniques. We record our continuity status and advance our project research under the unrecognized reasoning limits topic.
